name: Habitat management
check: Diversity plantations or nitrogen-fixing trees on boundaries, rain water conserved, organic and non-organic parts clearly separate, no parallel production.

name: Diversity management
check: Mixed cropping, intercropping or crop rotation instead of monocropping.

name: Livestock integration
check: Livestock kept with the crops so dung and urine are available for manuring.

name: Soil and water conservation
check: Erosion and salination prevented, no forest clearing, straw burning kept to a minimum.

name: Contamination control
check: Bunds or buffer zones against non-organic farms, separate storage, tools cleaned.

name: Conversion requirements
check: The conversion period is being followed and the records prove it.

name: Seeds and planting material
check: Organic seed, or untreated conventional seed only if organic is not available. No GMO seed.

name: Soil fertility and nutrients
check: Compost, green manure and rotations. No synthetic fertilizers, mineral nitrogen, chemical hormones or sewage sludge.

name: Pest, disease and weed management
check: Preventive and biological methods. No synthetic pesticides, herbicides or fungicides.
